conceptual_quality_basis: Lock-in requires a sharp, novel, coherent result with explanatory or unification value.
consequence_delta: Declarative tension: a Clay-valid route must keep gauge-invariant Wilson observables, OS positivity, continuum same-theory limits, nontriviality, and positive spectral mass gap simultaneously, but the current mass-scale concept is too weak and fragmented because m_{a,L} can be named without a carrier that survives cutoff removal. Compared with another abstract OS spectral bridge, the annular endpoint-R representation is sharper because it makes the physical carrier, sign, locality, and error budget computable. Efficient representation requirements are: encode endpoint Wilson sheets and annuli; preserve gauge invariance, reflection pairing, color/tensor contraction, locality, and same-theory normalization; allow primitive operations of reflection, annular summation, cumulant subtraction, interval contraction, and tail clipping; identify equivalence by induced Wilson cumulants; keep finite locality complexity plus summable tails; expose transfer through Schwinger convergence and OS positivity; and fail under proxy_shift, finite_to_global_gap, uniformity_gap, or no_falsifier. Visual metaphor: R is a reflected polarizing gasket between two Wilson endpoint boxes; the image preserves symmetry, locality, positivity/sign bookkeeping, and limiting-pressure through gasket leaks, but it hides nonabelian topology and can make finite-to-global transfer look too easy, so it is hypothesis_seed requiring preservation audit. Physical relevance is conditional: success changes the connected-cumulant physical carrier and the nontriviality gate; failure teaches that post-H,K endpoint polarization is not the unifying mechanism. General impact would be a clear finite obstruction or witness selection rule recognizable to constructive-QFT readers. Unification power is the compression of endpoint Schur complements, Wilson OPE recovery, reflection positivity, and large-field remainders into one interval certificate; the exposed new obligation is cutoff-uniform same-theory Schwinger transfer. Failure signature anticipated: finite_to_global_gap; if confirmed, run falsifier_sprint then quarantine rather than broad proof search.

main_problem_balance.allowed_claim: A consolidation may claim only a finite theorem, worked Wilson calculation, same-theory transfer boundary, or route-deciding obstruction whose assumptions and non-claims are explicit.
main_problem_balance.balance_test: Every local subgoal must name which larger YM gate it changes, which gate remains untouched, and why the local claim is still valuable without implying the full mass gap theorem.
forbidden_claims: A finite reflected-Wilson obstruction proves the continuum mass gap.
Endpoint-box positivity at fixed cutoff supplies OS/Wightman reconstruction.
A same-theory marker replaces a continuum transfer theorem.
A symbolic collar or toy calculation stands in for a gauge-invariant Wilson construction.
main_problem_balance.larger_problem_boundary: The Clay problem still requires a four-dimensional Yang-Mills quantum field theory satisfying the OS/Wightman axioms, a nontrivial continuum limit, and a positive Hamiltonian mass gap in the same theory.
main_problem_balance.local_subgoal_scope: Finite Route A subgoals: the reflected-Wilson Schur-Feshbach theorem, explicit H,K collar or hairpin objects, and post-H,K endpoint-box R/kappa_4 sign or interval certificates.
